finalText:
Big. `account_id` appears 1291 times across 94 of 97 files.

| Area | Hits | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 75 service files | 1200 | Rename freely |
| 12 migrations | 61 | Frozen, applied history |
| vendor `reporting-sdk` | 20 | Frozen, refresh overwrites it |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Frozen, public contract |
| `lib/serialize.js` | 5 | Left-hand key only |

In `serialize.js` the right-hand `'account_id'` is the public wire name. Watch two hidden costs. 125 of the service hits are SQL column names. Those need their own column-rename migration. Also `req.session.account_id` is set by middleware outside this repo.
